subject: Visibility add-ons billing scenarios and migration plan
messages:
From: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on billing for visibility add-ons / migration timeline

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're excited to move forward with Redwood for inference, and visibility (retention + traces + dashboards) is a key piece for our observability plan. Before procurement starts, we need clarification on how the add-ons will be billed when we migrate from our trial environment to a committed Dedicated cluster. Specific asks: 

- Do retention/trace charges begin as soon as telemetry is ingested or only after traffic is routed to the Dedicated pool?
- Can we get a one-time migration credit to offset double-charging during the cutover week?
- How do dashboard seats map to team seats vs. per-project metrics?

I've attached our procurement timeline and a quick list of expected ingestion volumes. We will loop in Procurement next week if these items are clear.

Attached: Procurement_PO_4321.pdf

Cheers,
Marta Gonzalez
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@acme.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on billing for visibility add-ons / migration timeline

Hi Marta — great to hear from you. Short answers up front, then a proposed path: 

- Billing start: telemetry ingest vs. dedicated routing.
  * If you keep telemetry routed to Hosted while we provision Dedicated, you are billed on Hosted add-on rates until traffic switches. Once you flip routing to Dedicated, billing moves to the Dedicated add-on SKU and we'll credit Hosted consumption for overlap where possible.

- Migration credit: we can offer a one-week migration credit (100% of visibility add-on charges) for the initial cutover if the Dedicated start date is within 30 days of signing the Dedicated commitment.

- Dashboard seats: we recommend mapping dashboard seats to 'team seats' (up to 10 dashboards per seat); project-level metrics are included in ingestion tiers. We'll include a seat-to-dashboard matrix in the SOW.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) Fast path: sign Dedicated commitment, pick a cutover date within 30 days -> you get 1-week migration credit. We'll supply a prefilled SOW and retention pricing workbook.
2) Phased path: keep core traffic on Hosted and pilot Dedicated for a slice of traffic; billing will be hybrid and we can provide a pro-rated migration credit.

I've attached the retention_pricing_model.xlsx with three scenarios (hosted-only, hybrid, dedicated-start). If you want, I can set a 30-minute call with Finance + Procurement to run numbers.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: retention_pricing_model.xlsx
From: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on billing for visibility add-ons / migration timeline

Thanks, Sergio — this is helpful. A few follow-ups from Procurement and the business: 

- Procurement asks for the migration credit to be documented in the SOW (amount + conditions).
- We are a mid-market account; is there flexibility to extend the credit window to 2 weeks if we sign within 45 days? The cutover date may slip slightly due to internal change control.
- Legal: need a clear definition of 'ingest' for retention pricing (is compressed archived data counted?).

Can you also confirm the billing account code and whether the visibility add-ons appear as separate line items on the invoice (preferred)? Procurement is more comfortable with discrete line items.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Marta

---
Attachment: Procurement_PO_4321.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@acme.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on billing for visibility add-ons / migration timeline

Hi Marta — looping in Legal/Finance notes. 

- We will put the migration credit language into the SOW: amount = 100% of the visibility add-on charges for the week of cutover; condition = cutover within the agreed commitment window. Sergio and I discussed your ask for a 2-week window. We can make that an exception for mid-market accounts with an approved amendment: 2-week credit if signed within 45 days, subject to finance approval.

- Definition of ingest: billed on ingest events before compression. Archives stored beyond 90 days move to an archival tier at reduced per-GB pricing. We'll add exact ingestion measurement language (bytes before compression, per-day ingestion metric) to the pricing appendix.

- Invoice presentation: yes — visibility add-ons appear as separate line items tied to the contract account code. We'll include sample invoice lines in the SOW appendix.

Sergio — can you confirm the migration-credit clause ID we should reference (SOW-CREDIT-01) and attach the SOW draft to this thread? Marta — when is Procurement available for a 30-min review this week?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on billing for visibility add-ons / migration timeline

Thanks all — quick sync on outcomes and attachments: 

- Confirm SOW clause: SOW-CREDIT-01 = one-week migration credit; exception clause SOW-CREDIT-01A = two-week migration credit (mid-market exception) — draft language is in the attached SOW (Acme_SOW_v1.pdf).
- Retention definition: "ingest" defined as pre-compression bytes accepted by Redwood's ingestion endpoint; archival tier kicks in at days >90. See pricing appendix in the SOW.
- Invoice lines: visibility.addons.retention, visibility.addons.tracing, visibility.addons.dashboards — will be discrete.
- Next step: Laura and I will incorporate the procurement comments into the SOW. Marta/Ethan, can we book 30 minutes Thursday 10:00 AM PT to walk Procurement through the SOW? If that works, we'll send an updated SOW by EOD Wednesday.

Attaching: Acme_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), retention_pricing_model.xlsx (updated scenario B with pro-rates).

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
